title_en: Psychology Made Simple (14/20): The Brainstorming Room
note_en: The pattern 不管…都… means "no matter…, still…": 不管是奇怪的还是普通的想法，都先说出来 "whether an idea is strange or ordinary, say it first." Inside 不管, the options are linked with 还是 (the "or" of questions), not 或者, and 都 before the verb marks that the result applies to every option. English needs "whether… or…"; Chinese needs both 不管 and 都.
